title: Automate Bug Bounty Hunting with 50 AI Agents (Open Source)
description:
Pentest-Agents is a free open-source framework that runs 50 AI agents to automate bug bounty hunting. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and OpenClaw — agents do recon, find vulnerabilities, chain exploits, and submit reports.
